Nina Patel: FYI AnvilEdge paused pilot until we provide a KMS attestation + explicit egress cap in SOW. CIO wants exec-level reassurance.

Samir Voss: Understood. Do they need BYO-KMS or is managed ok? Last note said BYO only for sensitive workloads.

Riley James: They insisted on BYO-KMS for EU data. Also asked for sustained 800 req/s embeddings p95 <120ms. We should validate with infra.

Priya Desai: I'll draft an attestation template referencing AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, and partner HSM. Need product to confirm rotation cadence recommendation.

Owen Blake: I'll run a short perf bench tomorrow morning. OpsBot please queue a test with model rwd-inf-embed-1, concurrency 64, seq_len 512, duration 300s.

OpsBot: Perf job scheduled for 2024-03-12 08:00 UTC. Results will post to #eng-runtime and link back here.

Samir Voss: Commercial: propose 3-week pilot, $20k trial credit, egress cap $4k for pilot. Legal wants the cap explicit. Priya, include conversion incentive?

Priya Desai: Yes - include option: if they convert to 6mo reserved within 30 days we waive onboarding fee. I'll add to SOW draft.

Nina Patel: Need internal owners for customer bridge tomorrow 9am PT: Samir (commercial), Riley (presales demo), Priya (attestation), Owen (perf). Can each commit?

Samir Voss: I can join.

Riley James: I'll run the demo and attach a one-pager.

Owen Blake: Perf bench owner. Will post results plus p50/p95/GPU util. If p95 >120ms propose burst node.

Priya Desai: Attestation draft done by EOD; will attach to invite. Recommending 90-day rotation and audit logs.

Nina Patel: Thanks. I'll send the invite and one-pager. Please post any redlines in this thread before the call. :white_check_mark:
